justifications.r1: 4-color mana fixing with green ramp, rituals, and rocks.
justifications.r2: Cascading spells grant immense free card advantage and storm velocity.
justifications.a1: Cascade velocity naturally digs deep through library.
justifications.a2: Connects with Yidris and chains cascade storms on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents massive multi-spell cascade turn on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p2: 1 opponent untap step or immediate same-turn storm kill.
justifications.p3: Yidris must connect combat damage to trigger cascade.
justifications.i1: Cyclonic Rift, Jeska's Will, and countermagic.
justifications.s1: Trample and evasion enablers protect combat connection.
justifications.s3: Spells can be hardcast without Yidris, but cascade is the centerpiece.
